sentences.quote: KPN today announces that Chris Figee will leave KPN on 1 November 2026 to join ASM International N.V. (ASM) to be nominated as Chief Financial Officer and member of the Management Board.
sentences.text: Chris Figee, CFO and member of the Board of Management since 1 February 2020, left KPN on 1 November 2026 to join ASM International as Chief Financial Officer.

sentences.quote: KPN announces that Wouter Stammeijer will be appointed Chief Financial Officer (CFO) effective 1 November. Vladimir Cibic will succeed him and will be appointed Chief Technology Officer (CTO) effective 1 November.
sentences.text: On 1 October 2026 KPN announced that Wouter Stammeijer, previously Chief Operating Officer, would become CFO effective 1 November, with Vladimir Cibic succeeding him as Chief Technology Officer from the same date, Cibic also being nominated to the Board of Management and Piero Overmars nominated to the Supervisory Board.

sentences.quote: KPN is simplifying its leadership structure and will continue with a five-member Board of Management. Effective 1 October, the Chief People Officer will report directly to the CEO.
sentences.text: KPN is simplifying its leadership structure, continuing with a five-member Board of Management, with the Chief People Officer reporting to the CEO from 1 October.
CEO Joost Farwerck said the appointments allow immediate focus on further accelerating execution of the company's plans.

mgmt_recent.text: Chris Figee, CFO and member of the Board of Management since 1 February 2020, left KPN on 1 November 2026 to join ASM International as Chief Financial Officer. On 1 October 2026 KPN announced that Wouter Stammeijer, previously Chief Operating Officer, would become CFO effective 1 November, with Vladimir Cibic succeeding him as Chief Technology Officer from the same date, Cibic also being nominated to the Board of Management and Piero Overmars nominated to the Supervisory Board. KPN is simplifying its leadership structure, continuing with a five-member Board of Management, with the Chief People Officer reporting to the CEO from 1 October.

sentences.text: KPN leads the Dutch fiber market, having expanded its footprint with joint venture Glaspoort to nearly six million households, with over 70 percent of its retail broadband base now on fiber.
KPN, together with Glaspoort, expanded its fiber footprint to nearly six million Dutch households and over 70% of its retail broadband base is on fiber.
Management targets roughly 3 percent average growth in service revenues and adjusted EBITDA after leases and about 7 percent free cash flow growth through 2027.

sentences.quote: Mid-term ambitions include ~3% CAGR for service revenues and adjusted EBITDA AL, and ~7% CAGR for Free Cash Flow through 2027.
sentences.text: Mid-term ambitions include ~3% CAGR for service revenues and adjusted EBITDA AL, and ~7% CAGR for Free Cash Flow through 2027.
Capital expenditure is set to drop by about 250 million euros to below 1 billion euros in 2027 as the heavy fiber build ends, lifting cash conversion.
KPN expects a significant step down in capex of about EUR 250 million in 2027, bringing total capex below EUR 1 billion, with operating free cash flow margins rising from 24% to about 30%.
